text:
alesha: flagging an odd deploybot pin: model=v2-embedding was pinned to runtime=2.9 on staging after a flurry of mismatch errors during daily canary. Opening thread to coordinate.

deploybot: auto-pin triggered: parameter-binding-errors >0.5% across staging-embeddings. Applied pin: runtime=3.0 -> 2.9 (block newer). Reason: runtime 3.0 changed embedding packing layout affecting v2 model's KV packing.

ben: I think this is the packing change we landed last week (PR #4892). It improved throughput for new models but old v2-embedding expects previous layout.

priya: correct. The model loader has a compatibility flag but it only covers FLOAT16 paths, not packed-embeddings. We have two options: (1) add a temporary loader shim in runtime 3.0 that accepts old packing; (2) keep pinning to 2.9 and schedule a model repackage for v2-embedding.

alesha: what's the effort estimate for each?

priya: shim: ~3-4 hours dev+test, requires infra restart on staging to pick up new runtime binary. Model repackage: ~1-2 hours to export new artifact and push; safer, but requires validation across embeddings pipeline.

infra-bot: Note: hotpatching runtime binaries on running nodes will trigger rolling restarts. Expect ~10m of degraded throughput per node during restart.

ben: given customer-facing production implications, my vote is to keep the pin on staging while we repackage the model and run validation, then unpin in the next change window. Shim is riskier and touches runtime internals.

alesha: agree. Repackage plan then. Priya, can your team handle the model artifact conversion and a quick regression suite?

priya: yes. Plan: create repackaged artifact, push to staging artifact repo, run embedding-consistency tests (sample vectors + cosine threshold), smoke against staging traffic. Estimated completion: 2.5h.

alesha: ok @deploybot please ensure pin TTL=12h on staging so it doesn't auto-unpin. Annotate: "packing-layout-v2-emb-repackage"

deploybot: acknowledged. Command queued:
```
/deploy pin runtime=3.0 -> 2.9 --scope staging-embeddings --ttl 12h --annot "packing-layout-v2-emb-repackage"
```

deploybot: pin applied at 1798889065. Will monitor.

ben: I'll add a note to the release notes: "Staging: v2-embedding pinned to runtime 2.9 due to packing layout incompatibility; engineering working on repack artifact."

priya: posting interim ticket with repro steps and test plan. After repack + validation, we'll request an unpin and schedule unpin for next change window (01:00 UTC) with canary->staging->prod gating.

alesha: thanks all. Keep updates in this thread. If repack hits snags, we'll revisit shim option. Closing for now but leave TTL active. :white_check_mark:
